## What the papers show (headline)

Scores sit at **14/20 on both papers** and the pattern is consistent:

1. **Time management is the main leak.** On both 09/16 papers he rushed or blanked the last stretch
   (Q16–20: "ran out of time", one question skipped, several "educated guess"). Roughly 4–6 marks per paper
   are lost to the clock, not to ability. → a **timing drill** (last 5 questions in 15 min) matters more than
   new content.
2. **Paper 2 (reasoning) — he second-guesses.** Many "C or D?", "B?", "E??" — he reaches the right region but
   cannot *confirm*. → drill **verification methods** (test a value, check a boundary), not more theory.
3. **Topic gaps** — the **09/04 audit** sharpened these. Almost every wrong/flagged question sits in one of
   three areas: **coordinate geometry (circles & the plane)**, **differentiation / stationary points**, and
   **range / max–min of rational & trig functions**. Below those: logs, ceiling integrals, and trig in
   unfamiliar form. See the **[09/04 error audit](set_2026-09-04.qmd)** for the question-by-question map.

His weak list overlaps ~90 % with the existing clinics, so lessons should **reuse** them rather than rebuild.
